create.name: Danielle LaPorte
create.bio:
Danielle LaPorte is a Canadian writer and teacher based in Vancouver whose work sits where everyday planning meets the inner life. Before turning to spiritual teaching she ran a futures research group in Washington, DC, building long-range scenarios for clients, and she later became known for The Desire Map, a method that asks people to name the feelings they most want and to shape goals around them. Her other books include The Fire Starter Sessions, White Hot Truth, How to Be Loving and, most recently, Bless and Release, about letting go and making room for what is wanted.

Today she teaches mainly online through recorded classes, short workshops, guided visualisations and printable meditation decks, many offered on a pay-what-you-choose basis, along with a monthly membership with live conversations. She hosts the With Love, Danielle podcast, designs the yearly Centered planner as a reflective practice, and trains people to lead heart-centred discussion circles in their own communities. Her tone is warm and direct, mixing devotional language with practical exercises for decisions, relationships and work. On Commune she teaches The Desire Map course and Free + Clear, a guided review of the past year.

books.title: The Desire Map: A Guide to Creating Goals with Soul
books.author: Danielle LaPorte
books.description: Her best-known book sets out a way of planning that starts from how you want to feel rather than what you want to own or achieve. Readers identify a handful of core feelings and use them to choose goals, habits and commitments across the main areas of life.

books.title: White Hot Truth: Clarity for Keeping It Real on Your Spiritual Path - from One Seeker to Another
books.author: Danielle LaPorte
books.description: A frank look at the self-help and spiritual culture she grew up in, with her own missteps along the way. She questions habits such as endless self-improvement and leans instead on self-compassion, discernment and trust in one's own inner guidance.

books.title: How to Be Loving: As Your Heart Is Breaking Open and Our World Is Waking Up
books.author: Danielle LaPorte
books.description: Short reflections and practices on choosing love in personal relationships and in a turbulent wider world. The book moves between contemplative ideas and everyday exercises for meeting difficulty with an open heart.

books.title: The Fire Starter Sessions: A Soulful + Practical Guide to Creating Success on Your Own Terms
books.author: Danielle LaPorte
books.description: Written for people building their own work or business, this book pairs candid career and money advice with questions about what success really means to the reader. Each chapter ends with prompts for reflection.

books.title: How to Be Loving: The Deck: For Resilience, Kindness, and All Kinds of Idealism
books.author: Danielle LaPorte
books.description: A card deck drawn from the book of the same name, each card offering a short prompt or affirmation. It is meant for a daily draw or as a quick reset during the day.

books.title: Style Statement: Live by Your Own Design
books.author: Carrie McCarthy, Danielle LaPorte
books.description: An early co-written book that helps readers sum up their personal style in two words and use that phrase to guide choices about home, work and daily life. It is built around questionnaires and examples.

courses.title: The Desire Map Course
courses.description: Her signature method taught in full on Commune, across four parts with a printable workbook and worksheets. Students name the feelings they want to live by and then plan goals and routines around them.

courses.title: Free + Clear
courses.description: A ten-day guided review of the last year or so, using your calendar and your feelings together. Short daily videos, worksheets and simple rituals help you decide what to carry forward and what to let go.

courses.title: The Super Blesser Experience
courses.description: A guided self-inquiry that goes with her book Bless and Release, though the book isn't required. The exercises focus on letting go of repetitive thinking and choosing consciously what to create next.

courses.title: Daily Energetics Course
courses.description: A planning system that matches the days of the week to planetary themes, so that some days are kept for reflection, some for decisions and some for rest and play. It is recorded and self-paced.

courses.title: Regulate to Relate: A Masterclass with Danielle LaPorte
courses.description: A recorded masterclass on noticing when you are about to react in a heated moment and choosing a calmer reply. It looks at the patterns behind arguments and offers simple ways to settle yourself first.

courses.title: Much Deeper Intimacy Workshop
courses.description: A short recorded workshop with printable prompts on how fear of rejection makes us pull back in relationships. It works through noticing that tightening, meeting it with compassion and using it as a signal to open up.

courses.title: The Savasana + Redwood Visualization (Deck + Guided Audio)
courses.description: A guided audio for lying still, paired with a printable card version, that uses the image of redwood trees and the earth for steadiness and gratitude. It is designed as a restful break from being busy.

courses.title: Infusion Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one strategy sessions with Danielle and her team for entrepreneurs and creative people. They combine business and marketing planning with questions of purpose, with an optional three-month follow-up block.

free_resources.title: INNER SUN Equinox Meditation
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation of about 25 minutes on her YouTube channel, recorded for the equinox. It uses the image of an inner sun to settle attention and set intentions for the coming season.
